name: A New Ore Sample
summary: At Camp Taurajo, Tatternack Steelforge seeks ore in Thousand Needles to strengthen the Horde’s arms. He sends you south for a sample to test.

sections.title: A Smith's Ambition
sections.body: Tatternack Steelforge is a blacksmith in Camp Taurajo, watched closely by Orgrimmar. He has already made weapons from local centaur armaments. Yet he still hopes to prove his craft to Warchief Thrall. Travelers passing through showed him strange ore taken from a kobold to the south. When they refused to sell it, he took the refusal as an insult to his craft and the Horde.

sections.title: Venture into Thousand Needles
sections.body: You leave the southern Barrens’ flat plains for the towering canyon maze of Thousand Needles. Kobold diggers tunnel through its crags and cliffs. Bring back chunks of unrefined ore taken directly from them. Then Tatternack can judge whether the raw mineral can be forged into weapons for Thrall’s war effort.

faq.answer: Tatternack Steelforge is an orc weaponsmith at Camp Taurajo in the southern Barrens. He crafts weapons for the Horde’s frontier defense and seeks new materials to impress Warchief Thrall.

faq.q: Where does this ore sample come from?
faq.answer: Kobolds carry the unrefined ore through Thousand Needles’ winding canyons, south of the Great Lift at the Barrens’ border.

faq.q: Why is Tatternack angry at the passing travelers?
faq.answer: Travelers from the south showed Tatternack a strange mineral chunk taken from a slain kobold, then refused to sell it. He saw their refusal to share vital materials as an unpatriotic insult to the Warchief and cursed them as cowards.

faq.q: What will Tatternack do with the ore?
faq.answer: Tatternack plans to study the ore’s metal and test its strength. If it proves durable enough, he intends to forge a prototype weapon and present it to Warchief Thrall in Orgrimmar.

faq.q: What prerequisite must be completed before this task?
faq.answer: First, you complete Weapons of Choice by gathering specific weapons from the centaur tribes threatening Camp Taurajo. This proves that local armaments can be repurposed.

faq.q: Why are kobolds in Thousand Needles carrying this ore?
faq.answer: Kobolds burrow and mine, tunneling through crags and underground veins. In Thousand Needles, their digging has uncovered unusual deposits rarely touched by those who live above ground.

angles.text: As a Horde smith, you help secure new metal deposits to keep the frontier armed against nearby threats.
At Camp Taurajo, you can supply materials for the Warchief’s military preparations from the Horde’s southern bastion.
As a prospector, you know the worth of raw veins unearthed by burrowing creatures in the unexplored southern canyons.
